name: Kotokura Mitsuru
source:
She is the daughter of the Kotokura family, a branch of the Ugaya family, and works as an attendant for Shizuki Ugaya, Tamaki Kasuga's grandmother, and lives with the Ugaya family.
Her cooking skills are at a professional level.
